resources.string: This build only captures the screen on this device. It does not pair, stream, or allow remote control.
Starting screen share opens the official Android screen-capture dialog. PhoneBeam cannot capture until you approve that system prompt. There is no in-app substitute for it.

Frame counts prove MediaProjection is producing buffers. Switch to another app, then return: the count should keep rising and the last frame should show that app. A live thumbnail while PhoneBeam is visible will recurse; that is expected and is not a network preview.
Last captured frame (downscaled, memory only, not saved).
Shown the entire time PhoneBeam is capturing this screen.
Screen capture is active. Stop sharing from this notification or in the app.
A visible notification is required while capturing. Screen share was not started.
Android denied screen capture. Nothing was captured.
Android stopped the projection. A new system permission is required before capturing again.
